column6: Author name misspelled "Phillip K. Dick"; corrected to "Philip K. Dick".

Prompt asked what "Bloodchild" would lose "if the implantation were painless and freely chosen," which presupposes the implantation is painful and unchosen; in the story the horror lies in the grubs cut from Lomas, and Gan makes a choice at the end. Replaced with a question about the Lomas scene and Gan's final choice.

Misquoted opening of The Big Sleep ("with sun in the windows and a view of the Hollywood sign"); restored the actual line "with the sun not shining and a look of hard wet rain in the clearness of the foothills".
LaValle / The Ballad of Black Tom retelling "The Horror at Red Hook" checked.

Old How section listed Ted Chiang's "Story of Your Life" as a contemporary cosmic horror expansion; it is a first-contact linguistics story, not cosmic horror. Replaced with LaValle's The Ballad of Black Tom (matches q:4). Old misconceptions section is unbulleted prose; left as is.
Old How section cites Martha Grimes as a contemporary cozy, though her Richard Jury is a Scotland Yard professional; borderline, left as is.
Old q:2 (true-false "crime and detective fiction can both feature criminals as protagonists", key false) is shaky wording; not certain enough to change, left as is.
Dixie Flatline (McCoy Pauley ROM construct) and his request to be erased checked.
Style only: banned word "essential" replaced ("cannot be changed").
